method: Target = implied forward EPS x (1 + growth) x target P/E. Overweight if expected 12-month return (price upside + dividend yield) >= 8%, else Underweight. AI-generated opinion, not investment advice.

ABT.thesis: Diversified med-tech/diagnostics compounder at ~18x forward EPS, below its historical premium multiple. Consensus sees ~9% EPS growth into 2027; the infant-formula DOJ settlement (~$384M) removes an overhang.
ABT.risk: Q3 report Oct 21 could reset the diagnostics/nutrition outlook; multiple recovery may be slow.
ABT.basis: Fwd EPS $5.90 x 1.09 (1-yr growth +9%) x 19x target P/E

ADBE.thesis: About 9x forward non-GAAP EPS with ~12% revenue growth: the market is already pricing in serious AI disruption. Modest EPS growth plus a small re-rating gives a double-digit return.
ADBE.risk: Two recent downgrades (Wells Fargo to Underweight, HSBC to Hold) cite slowing organic growth. If creative-software seats erode, the stock is cheap for a reason.
ADBE.basis: Fwd EPS $28.12 x 1.05 (1-yr growth +5%) x 9.5x target P/E

ASTS.thesis: No earnings to anchor a multiple (TTM revenue $115M, net loss $619M), so the target is a scenario blend: bull ~$100 (20%), base ~$40 (35%), bear ~$10 (45%). Stock is near its 52-week low after SpaceX spectrum/competition news.
ASTS.risk: Binary outcomes: constellation build-out and carrier deals vs. dilution, competition and the pending class-action. Position sizing matters more than the rating here.
ASTS.basis: Scenario-weighted: 20% x $100 + 35% x $40 + 45% x $10 (about $38); no earnings anchor

BABA.thesis: Trades ~14x forward EPS with cloud/AI growth, but TTM EPS is down ~52% on heavy investment. A stabilizing earnings base plus a modest multiple recovery gives upside; consensus targets look stale-high.
BABA.risk: China regulatory/geopolitical risk, capex-driven margin pressure, and the ADS discount to Western peers.
BABA.basis: Fwd EPS $7.83 x 1.10 (1-yr growth +10%) x 15x target P/E

BKNG.thesis: Best-in-class travel platform at ~14.5x forward EPS, well under its history, with ~13% revenue and ~12% EPS growth and heavy buybacks.
BKNG.risk: FTC action over hotel ads, AI-agent disintermediation fears, and the EU blocking the eTraveli deal; analysts have been cutting targets.
BKNG.basis: Fwd EPS $11.57 x 1.12 (1-yr growth +12%) x 16x target P/E

CRM.thesis: ~16x forward EPS for an ~11% grower with expanding margins and large buybacks; Agentforce is the upside option. BofA's upgrade from Underperform shows sentiment turning.
CRM.risk: AI agents could compress per-seat revenue; Agentforce security flaws and acquisition spree (Loops, Listen Labs) add execution risk.
CRM.basis: Fwd EPS $15.16 x 1.09 (1-yr growth +9%) x 16.5x target P/E

EXE.thesis: Largest U.S. gas producer at ~11x forward EPS. Forward EPS ($8.1) is below TTM ($11.6), so the market already expects gas prices to fade. My model lands right at the return hurdle, so this is effectively neutral.
EXE.risk: Earnings swing with natural-gas prices, which I cannot forecast; consensus targets (+35%) assume a stronger price deck than the stock implies.
EXE.basis: Fwd EPS $8.14 x 1.05 (1-yr growth +5%) x 11.5x target P/E

ISRG.thesis: Dominant robotic-surgery franchise growing revenue ~21% and EPS ~21%. Shares are ~30% off their high after the July drop, so the multiple has already compressed.
ISRG.risk: Premium valuation (~37x forward), management held rather than raised procedure-growth guidance, and Oct 20 earnings land soon.
ISRG.basis: Fwd EPS $11.41 x 1.14 (1-yr growth +14%) x 37x target P/E

LULU.thesis: Cheap at ~11x forward EPS, but forward EPS ($8.70) is well below TTM ($12.22) and revenue growth is ~2%. I would wait for earnings to stabilize before calling a bottom.
LULU.risk: Upside if the turnaround under new product/leadership structure works; downside if estimates keep falling. Securities-fraud investigations add noise.
LULU.basis: Fwd EPS $8.71 x 0.97 (1-yr growth -3%) x 11x target P/E

LVS.thesis: ~11x forward EPS with revenue +18% and EPS +31% on Macau/Singapore recovery. Near its 52-week low, so expectations are low. Dividend not included in the return.
LVS.risk: Macau/China macro weakness and VIP softness (Argus downgrade); several targets were just cut (Goldman to $47). Oct 21 earnings next.
LVS.basis: Fwd EPS $3.27 x 1.08 (1-yr growth +8%) x 13x target P/E

MELI.thesis: Latin America's e-commerce + fintech leader with ~46% revenue growth. EPS is lagging revenue because of credit and logistics investment; if margins normalize, EPS growth should catch up.
MELI.risk: Premium multiple (~44x forward); margin investment could continue; Argentina/Brazil macro and credit quality.
MELI.basis: Fwd EPS $42.13 x 1.22 (1-yr growth +22%) x 40x target P/E

META.thesis: ~23x forward EPS with ~28% revenue growth and enormous cash generation; analyst targets are rising. Upside is solid but not huge after the run to near the 52-week high.
META.risk: FY27 expense and capex guidance is the key debate going into Oct 21 earnings; TTM EPS is down ~4%.
META.basis: Fwd EPS $31.25 x 1.12 (1-yr growth +12%) x 23x target P/E

MSFT.thesis: Highest-quality compounder in the group: ~18% revenue growth, ~32% EPS growth, Azure/AI demand. At a fresh record high the return is only modestly above my hurdle.
MSFT.risk: Valuation leaves little room for a miss; reports of Azure cost cuts and AI-capex payback questions.
MSFT.basis: Fwd EPS $19.80 x 1.14 (1-yr growth +14%) x 26x target P/E

NFLX.thesis: ~20x forward EPS for ~16% revenue growth and ~36% EPS growth, down ~40% over the year. I do not have a verified explanation for the de-rating, so conviction is low.
NFLX.risk: Layoffs (~6%), a Sell downgrade, and engagement/spend questions; Oct 20 earnings are the next test.
NFLX.basis: Fwd EPS $3.59 x 1.15 (1-yr growth +15%) x 22x target P/E

NKE.thesis: Revenue is still shrinking (-1.2%) and forward EPS ($1.41) is below TTM ($2.09). At ~26x depressed earnings the stock already prices a recovery; I see no clear earnings-inflection catalyst inside 12 months.
NKE.risk: Upside if the Elliott Hill turnaround surprises (Bernstein calls the numbers 'de-risked'); downside from more guidance cuts and layoffs.
NKE.basis: Fwd EPS $1.41 x 1.20 (1-yr growth +20%) x 22x target P/E

NOW.thesis: Enterprise-workflow leader with ~22% revenue growth; targets are being raised (Wells Fargo $190, Evercore $175). ~31x forward EPS is fair for the growth.
NOW.risk: Software multiples are sensitive to AI-disruption narratives and rates; GAAP EPS is thin.
NOW.basis: Fwd EPS $4.73 x 1.19 (1-yr growth +19%) x 29x target P/E

NVO.thesis: ~11.6x forward EPS with a ~3.3% dividend. Obesity-drug competition and the FDA delay are priced in; modest EPS growth plus a small re-rating works.
NVO.risk: UBS calls it a possible value trap; GLP-1 share loss to Lilly, pricing pressure, and the denecimig delay.
NVO.basis: Fwd EPS $3.38 x 1.03 (1-yr growth +3%) x 12.5x target P/E; includes 3.26% dividend yield in return

ORCL.thesis: Down ~60% from its high while revenue grows ~22% and EPS ~48%; ~15x forward EPS looks cheap if the AI-cloud backlog converts (Tencent, OpenAI-related demand).
ORCL.risk: I did not verify free cash flow or debt (not on the quote page); heavy debt-funded capex, OpenAI concentration, and rate-hike jitters are the bear case.
ORCL.basis: Fwd EPS $8.52 x 1.12 (1-yr growth +12%) x 16x target P/E

OSCR.thesis: Revenue +43% and raised 2026 guidance, but the stock has tripled from its low and now sits at its 52-week high. My model gives a return just under the hurdle.
OSCR.risk: ACA marketplace subsidy/regulatory risk, medical-cost trend; BofA is at Underperform ($30).
OSCR.basis: Fwd EPS $1.82 x 1.35 (1-yr growth +35%) x 15x target P/E

PEP.thesis: ~15x forward EPS with a ~4.5% dividend yield, historically high for PepsiCo. Cut guidance is already in the price; defensive cash flow supports the dividend.
PEP.risk: Volume declines in soda, GLP-1 headwinds to snacks, repeated guidance cuts.
PEP.basis: Fwd EPS $8.59 x 1.06 (1-yr growth +6%) x 16x target P/E; includes 4.51% dividend yield in return

PFE.thesis: Cheap at ~10.6x forward EPS with a 5.8% yield, but at its 52-week high with revenue flat and a patent-cliff drag. Dividend plus flat price roughly equals ~5% return, below my hurdle.
PFE.risk: Upside from pipeline/FDA wins (Tukysa); consensus target ($29.26) is below the current price.
PFE.basis: Fwd EPS $2.81 x 1.00 (1-yr growth +0%) x 10.5x target P/E; includes 5.78% dividend yield in return

SE.thesis: ~43% revenue growth, ~33% EPS growth, and 25% GMV growth guidance at ~22x forward EPS, ~48% off its high.
SE.risk: Margin concerns (DBS downgrade), Q2 EPS missed, Shopee competition (TikTok, Temu).
SE.basis: Fwd EPS $4.32 x 1.22 (1-yr growth +22%) x 21x target P/E

SPOT.thesis: Pricing power and operating leverage drive earnings growth; the stock is ~25% off its high. Returns are only just above my hurdle at ~35x forward EPS, so there is little margin for error.
SPOT.risk: Mixed analyst moves (StoneX downgrade, Cantor cut) ahead of Oct 22 earnings; premium multiple.
SPOT.basis: Fwd EPS $15.16 x 1.21 (1-yr growth +21%) x 31x target P/E

TMDX.thesis: Organ-transplant logistics leader with ~26% revenue growth and 2026 revenue guidance of $737-757M; EPS should scale faster than revenue. ~52% below its high.
TMDX.risk: TTM EPS ($4.01) vs forward ($1.79) mismatch suggests one-time items; shareholder investigations; Q2 EPS missed.
TMDX.basis: Fwd EPS $1.79 x 1.40 (1-yr growth +40%) x 34x target P/E

TTWO.thesis: Earnings leverage to GTA VI. Consensus has ~38% upside; I haircut the growth assumption for delay risk. Release timing in my data is reported, not confirmed.
TTWO.risk: Another GTA VI delay or weak launch would hit estimates; PC-port and leak headlines are volatile; GAAP EPS is currently negative.
TTWO.basis: Fwd EPS $8.44 x 1.25 (1-yr growth +25%) x 24x target P/E

UBER.thesis: ~17x forward EPS with ~17% revenue growth, down ~30% from its high on autonomous-vehicle fears; Waymo/Pony.ai partnerships make it more of a distributor than a victim.
UBER.risk: Capital-allocation worries (Delivery Hero $14.8B bid, ezCater $2.3B), AV platform disruption, regulatory risk.
UBER.basis: Fwd EPS $4.07 x 1.17 (1-yr growth +17%) x 17.5x target P/E

UNH.thesis: Q3 beat and raised 2026 guidance (adj. EPS of at least $20.50); ~17.5x forward EPS with a 2.3% dividend. Earnings power is rebuilding.
UNH.risk: Medical-cost trend, Texas AG investigation, and the stock is up sharply today (+3.6%).
UNH.basis: Fwd EPS $23.41 x 1.08 (1-yr growth +8%) x 18x target P/E; includes 2.27% dividend yield in return

WDAY.thesis: ~15.6x forward EPS with ~13% revenue growth; Anthropic partnership and agentic acquisitions may help. FY28 subscription growth guided to only ~11%.
WDAY.risk: AI could reduce HR/finance software seats; Hold ratings from UBS, Jefferies, Stifel.
WDAY.basis: Fwd EPS $12.07 x 1.12 (1-yr growth +12%) x 15.5x target P/E

WMT.thesis: Excellent operator, but at ~39x forward EPS with ~6% revenue growth the stock needs a lot to go right. Return is roughly the dividend plus a little.
WMT.risk: Deutsche Bank upgraded to Buy ($136) on e-commerce/advertising mix; automation setbacks reported by WSJ.
WMT.basis: Fwd EPS $3.10 x 1.09 (1-yr growth +9%) x 36x target P/E; includes 0.82% dividend yield in return

ZETA.thesis: Marketing-cloud platform with ~36% revenue growth, GAAP profit near breakeven, and several targets just raised (Roth $55). Shares are near the 52-week high.
ZETA.risk: Thin GAAP earnings, high multiple, acquisition integration, insider-related legal notices.
ZETA.basis: Fwd EPS $1.08 x 1.30 (1-yr growth +30%) x 27.5x target P/E

IBIT.thesis: Spot bitcoin ETF. Bitcoin has no cash flows, so I have no valuation framework that would justify an Overweight/Underweight call or a price target. Shown for completeness.
IBIT.risk: Highly volatile; bitcoin near ~$85K, down ~3% this week; flows have slowed since mid-July.
IBIT.basis: No cash flows to value; no price target.

ETH.thesis: Grayscale Ethereum staking mini ETF. Same limitation as bitcoin: no earnings to anchor a target, so no rating. Fund is down ~42% over one year.
ETH.risk: Highly volatile; crypto legislation uncertainty ('Clarity Act' failed by 11 votes).
ETH.basis: No cash flows to value; no price target.
